2. By means of the present application,
the applicant seeks grant of anticipatory
bail in connection with F.I.R./Case Crime
No.462 of 2025, registered at Police
Station Pathari, District Haridwar, for the
offence punishable under Sections 103(1),
333, 351(2), 352, 115(2) & 3(5) of B.N.S.,
2023.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant
submits that the applicant is innocent and
has been falsely implicated in the present
case. It is submitted that a Coordinate
Bench of this Court, vide order dated
29.05.2026, granted interim anticipatory
bail to the applicant and, in compliance
with the conditions stipulated therein, the
applicant has duly cooperated with the
investigation as and when called upon by
the Investigating Officer. It is further
submitted that the investigation has since
been concluded and the charge-sheet has

UKHC010088292026
2026:UHC:7609
already been filed before the competent
Court. Learned counsel contends that no
material has been brought on record by
the prosecution to demonstrate that the
custodial interrogation of the applicant is
either necessary or warranted at this
stage. It is, therefore, prayed that the
interim anticipatory bail granted to the
applicant be confirmed and made
absolute.
4. Having heard learned counsel for the
parties, perused the material available on
record and considered the rival
submissions, this Court finds that the
applicant has remained protected by
virtue of the interim order dated and has
duly complied with the conditions
incorporated therein by extending full
cooperation during the course of
investigation. The investigation has
culminated in submission of the charge-sheet before the competent Court. No
material has been placed before this Court
to indicate that the applicant has misused
the liberty granted to him or has failed to
cooperate with the investigating agency. It
is also not the case of the prosecution that
the custodial interrogation of the applicant
is required at this stage. Having regard to
the nature of the allegations, the stage of
the proceedings, the conduct of the
applicant during the period of interim
protection and the facts and
circumstances of the case, and without
expressing any opinion on the merits of
the prosecution case, this Court is of the
considered opinion that the applicant has
made out a fit case for confirmation of the
interim anticipatory bail granted earlier.
5. Consequently, the interim
anticipatory bail granted to the applicant
vide order dated 29.05.2026 is hereby
confirmed and made absolute. The

applicant shall remain on anticipatory bail
on the same terms and conditions as
contained in the aforesaid order and shall
continue to cooperate with the trial
proceedings. It shall also be open to the
learned trial Court to impose such further
conditions, if considered necessary, in
accordance with law.
6. Accordingly, the anticipatory bail
application stands allowed.
 (Alok Mahra, J.) 21.08.2026
